pointsOfInterest.name: African Elephants
pointsOfInterest.description: The African elephant is the largest land animal on Earth. They are known for their intelligence, strong family bonds, and impressive memory.

pointsOfInterest.name: Orangutans
pointsOfInterest.description: Orangutans are great apes known for their distinctive red fur and high intelligence. They are primarily arboreal and spend most of their time in trees.
facts: Have the longest interbirth interval of any land mammal

pointsOfInterest.name: Gibbon apes
pointsOfInterest.description: Gibbons are small apes known for their agility and acrobatic skills. They are excellent brachiators, swinging from branch to branch with ease.
facts: Known for their loud, melodious calls

pointsOfInterest.name: Lunch place
pointsOfInterest.description: A great spot to relax and enjoy a meal while observing the beautiful surroundings of the park.
facts: Offers a variety of local and international cuisines
Scenic views of the park's landscape

pointsOfInterest.name: The Flower Temple
pointsOfInterest.description: The Flower Temple is dedicated to the universe of flowers, in accordance with the animistic principles in Balinese Hinduism that every form of life is of divine origin, worthy of a temple.
facts: The water, the cradle of all life, flows along its flank, accompanied by 2 small dragon snakes.
The Candi Kurung, the supreme edifice in lava stone from the holiest of mountains, Mount Agung, represents the sky and the wind.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Craftsman’s House
pointsOfInterest.description: Near the wall of the Abbey, providing a genuine sanctuary dedicated to the elephant, a real Thai house, all in wood, the elegant roof on two levels and the columns supporting it rescued from a previous building that was destroyed by fire. There you can admire its numerous sculptures on various wooden supports, inspired above all by the elephant, which is a sacred animal in Asia. It reigns supreme in this place, away from the crowd, a peaceful atmosphere conducive to a little meditation.
facts: Craftsman’s House, in the details of its decor, and, with a little bit of imagination or reverie, you shouldn’t be surprised to see the saffron-coloured robe of a Buddhist monk appear.
